title: Copper Does the Early Work
description:
Iron is scarce here — no villages means no iron golems, and no hostile mobs means no drops. Mining is the only source.

So this pack lets **copper** do the early jobs. Shears and buckets can both be made from copper ingots, using the same shapes as the iron versions.

Copper is everywhere, and you'll want shears for wool and a bucket for milk long before you want to go mining.

*Press U on a copper ingot to see everything it makes.*

objectives.name: Craft copper shears or a bucket
